text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Military administrator of eastern Imo state, Colonel Tanko Zubairu, confirms death sentence on six persons condemned by an armed robbery tribunal. The seventh had his sentence commuted to life jail because he was a minor at the time of the robbery in 1995.
- The federal government has dimissed rumours that it plans to tax churches and mosques.
- Opposition NADECO protests against remarks by police chief Ibrahim Coomasie that it is responsible for bomb blasts in Nigeria.
- Nigeria's aviation college takes delivery of three trainer aircraft from France.
